analysis: The trial succeeded operationally and achieved pinned-host macro validation HR@10=0.5713, matching the prior recurrent-attention result and remaining 0.0024 below the historical 0.5737 reference. Per-category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.605, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.600, Electronics 0.435, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.645. The zero-initialized learned relative-recency bias produced no observed improvement in the reported aggregate metric; these results do not establish why. Electronics remains the weakest category. No test metrics were available.
code_summary: One independently trained GRURec checkpoint per category, with dataset routing. Each network uses shared 96-dimensional input/candidate embeddings, input normalization and dropout, a two-layer GRU, and strictly preceding nonpadding query-key-value attention. A jointly trained 32-entry scalar relative-distance bias uses exact buckets for distances 0–15 and logarithmic buckets thereafter, initialized to zero. Concatenated recurrent states and attention summaries pass through projection and normalization; scoring uses normalized shared embeddings, learned scale, and jointly trained item biases. Training retains 64-negative sampled softmax, AdamW, AMP, clipping, and validation HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG@10 tie-breaking and 25-epoch patience. The predictor strictly loads one complete selected checkpoint per category. No ensembles, checkpoint averaging, or separately fitted scores are used.
